jobs.title: reddit: Senior Product Adoption Strategist (Shopping)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, US
URL: https://redditinc.com/

Senior Product Adoption Strategist (Shopping)

Remote - United States
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 116 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Location: NYC

We’re assembling a collaborative team of individuals to drive Reddit Ads product adoption within our Global Sales organization and with advertisers. The Product Adoption team’s mission is to accelerate and scale the adoption of priority products and features to drive advertiser success and revenue growth. We are looking for our next team member who can help us to innovate and scale across our major adoption programs. 

In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Shopping product adoption across Large Customer Sales and Mid-Market advertisers worldwide. You will partner with Sales to pitch, onboard, activate, and grow advertisers on our Shopping product solutions and activate high-priority business opportunities. building global ads product adoption programs for advertisers and agencies. Your close partners will also include Product, PMM, Strategy & Ops, Enablement, and Marketing Science. 

You will drive the activation of our Shopping ads products to meet our customers' performance goals. You will work directly with account teams and advertisers to pitch, onboard, and activate across our Shopping solutions. Additionally, you will advocate for advertiser Shopping product needs, opportunities, and gaps within Reddit’s R&D organization. 

Why Join Reddit’s Product Adoption Team?

  • Innovative Environment: Be part of a newly reimagined team at one of the most dynamic platforms worldwide, contributing to groundbreaking strategies that drive growth.
  • Career Advancement: Significant opportunities for career development and mobility as you help shape the future of product adoption at Reddit.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a group of thoughtful, smart, and adaptable individuals who value collaboration and support each other's growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive Growth: Lead efforts to scale the adoption of Reddit’s Shopping ads products, increasing advertiser engagement and revenue.
  • Develop Channel Strategies: Create and implement sales strategies tailored to Shopping ads programs in support of Large Customer Sales (LCS) and Mid-Market advertisers and sales teams worldwide.
  • Engage Clients: Work directly with advertisers to identify, pitch, activate, onboard, and grow clients with strategic product opportunities.
  • Enable Sales: Customize enablement for sales by channel and ensure that teams have the necessary knowledge, training, collateral, and market insights to effectively position and implement Reddit's Shopping ad products.
  • Leverage Partners: Work with 3P partners to accelerate Shopping ads growth. 
  • Foster Feedback Loop: Advocate for advertiser needs and identify opportunities and gaps, providing feedback to PMM and Product teams to inform ongoing product development.
  • Measure results: Partner with Sales and Strategy & Operations leadership to track progress to goal and identify steps that can be taken to accelerate outcomes.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, sales, marketing strategy, operations, or relevant industries
  • Industry Experience: A strong background in product adoption, growth, or sales strategy within the digital advertising industry.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with partner teams, leveraging cross-functional expertise to drive program success.
  • Proficient in Google Suite and Salesforce.
  • Passion for understanding client needs and delivering solutions that drive their success.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Direct Shopping product and/or eCommerce experience 
  • Analytical Skills: Solid familiarity with data analysis techniques and tools such as Mode, Tableau, and Salesforce to track key metrics and outcomes.
  • Project Management: Excellent program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of clearly articulating strategies and outcomes to internal and external stakeholders.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave  

 

 

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and will also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

$126,000 - $176,400 USD

We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

jobs.title: Apollo: Business Recruiter
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://www.apollo.io/es

About the Role

Apollo is hiring a Business Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting across our G&A, Sales and Marketing organizations. This is a high-ownership role on a lean, high-performing team. You will manage a portfolio of mid and senior-level requisitions, build and execute sourcing strategies, and serve as a genuine business partner to your hiring managers. This role requires someone who operates with low oversight, self-diagnoses problems before they escalate, and brings a talent advisor posture to every stakeholder conversation. The best person for this role brings their own operating system and makes the team around them sharper.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for mid and senior-level roles across G&A, Sales and Marketing, with consistent delivery across multiple verticals simultaneously
  • Build and execute sourcing strategies that generate qualified, diverse pipelines, and adapt those strategies based on funnel performance, not just instinct
  • Conduct structured screens and interviews, design interview plans, and lead calibrated debriefs that result in clear, defensible hiring decisions
  • Manage 20+ phone screens per week and drive 360+ outbound contacts per quarter
  • Hold the bar on candidate quality, give direct and honest feedback, and avoid passing weak profiles to sidestep an uncomfortable conversation
  • Maintain accurate, real-time pipeline data in Greenhouse and self-report on progress to leadership without being asked
  • Track funnel metrics, identify root causes of slowdowns, and bring data-informed recommendations to stakeholder conversations
  • Partner with hiring managers and business leaders as a talent advisor: shape role scoping, set expectations on candidate profiles, and influence as a subject matter expert.
  • Work cross-functionally with Finance, HR, and Compensation to navigate offer approvals and headcount processes with operational integrity
  • Build or improve multiple workflows, processes, or tools that create efficiency beyond your own req load

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a focus on Sales, Revenue, or Marketing roles in SaaS
  • Demonstrated delivery in high-growth environments where you managed complexity and ambiguity
  • Comfort and credibility working with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to challenge and influence, not just execute
  • Strong data fluency: you monitor your own funnel health, diagnose issues before they surface in a check-in, and use data to drive stakeholder conversations
  • Proven AI and process efficiency capability: you have built repeatable workflows or automation that measurably improved your output, and you can speak to what you built, why it works, and what changed
  • Familiarity with Revenue teams, high-performing marketing orgs, and product-led growth models
  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse and Gem, with clean data hygiene as a non-negotiable operating habit
  • Clear, direct communicator who can influence without authority across functions
  • High agency: you identify problems, generate solutions, and drive progress without waiting for direction

jobs.title: Cranky Concierge: Travel Coordinator
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Long Beach, CA
URL: https://crankyconcierge.com/

The Travel Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to manage inbound emails and phone calls, facilitate customer onboarding, and keep the virtual office running smoothly. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys staying organized, communicating clearly, and helping keep things moving in a fast-paced environment.

Schedule

This is a full-time, fully remote position and the standard working hours are 10am to 7pm ET Monday through Friday.

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage inbound emails and phone calls in a timely and professional manner.

  • Set up new trips for the Travel Planning team to work on.

  • Be the friendly, professional first point of contact for our clients.

  • Inform new and existing clients about our services and pricing.

  • Assist with administrative tasks such as processing refunds, filing for compensation, and other pre- and post-travel tasks as needed. 

  • As time allows, assist with travel planning tasks including but not limited to: quoting travel insurance, purchasing seat assignments, and issuing tickets.

If this sounds like the kind of thing you like to do, then keep reading!

What Matters in this Role

  • Reliability. The team will be depending on you to stay on top of and manage the daily flow of client communications.

  • English proficiency. Native-level written and verbal English is required.

  • Attention to detail. You’ll be managing a lot of information, sometimes under time pressure, so accuracy matters.

  • Ability to work under pressure. You’re responsible for ensuring that the relevant information reaches the right person in a timely manner even when there’s a lot going on. 

  • Humility and teamwork. If you don't know the answer, be willing to ask others on the team for help.

  • Calm and collected. You must be able to roll with the punches and maintain a calm demeanor. The client may be stressed and angry; you can't be.

  • U.S. Work Authorization. To do this job, you’ll need to be legally authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer, without sponsorship. 

  • Background check. A clean background check will be required as this role involves handling sensitive client data.

  • Location. This is a remote position, but you must be available and accessible during your standard working hours.

  • Technology. You’ll need your own computer (Windows or Mac), reliable high-speed internet and a smartphone (Android or iPhone). 

  • Workspace. You’ll need access to a quiet work environment to accommodate communication with clients via email and phone. 

Compensation

  • Starting at $17/hr, depending on skills and experience 

Benefits 

  • 15 days of PTO per year, accruing from date of hire

  • Paid Federal holidays

  • Health insurance

  • 3% retirement match 

  • Monthly phone and internet stipend 

  • Access to exclusive travel industry discounts after 6 months of employment

  • Two company get-togethers each year

We can't stress enough how important attention to detail is, so please be sure to tell us your favorite airline in your application.

jobs.title: Databricks: Delivery Solutions Architect - Startups & Emerging Enterprise
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - California; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Illinois; Remote - Massachusetts; Remote - New York; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform with Startup and Emerging Enterprise customers. You will also help ensure customer success by helping our most complex customers maximize the value they get out of our platform and their return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases by leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. It is technical in the sense that you will serve as the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels within an organization. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. 

The impact you will have:

  • Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
  • Lead the post-technical-win account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
  • Be the accountable technical leader for specific use cases and customers across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads the customer has chosen to run on Databricks
  • Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often spanning multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
  • Leverage Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, and escalate to subject matter experts when work falls beyond your scope or expertise
  • Create, own, and execute a point of view on how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
  • Partner with Databricks Product and Engineering teams on new product innovations, private previews, and upgrades
  • Develop an execution plan spanning all customer-facing technical roles and teams across the following work streams:
    • Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
    • Enablement / user growth plan
    • Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
    • Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
    • Executive and operational governance
  • Provide internal and external updates to your Technical GM — KPI reporting on usage and customer health, covering investment status, key risks, product adoption, and use case progression

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of experience accountable for technical project / program delivery in Data and AI, with the ability to contribute to technical debate and design choices alongside customers
  • Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala 
  • Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
  • Understanding of solution architecture for distributed data systems
  • Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverable
  • Technical program or project management, including accountability for accounts, stakeholders, and resources
  • Experience resolving complex, high-stakes escalations with senior customer executives
  • Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing delivery of complex programs/projects
  • Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.title: Lattice: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

What You Will Do

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice. 

If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

  • Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.
  • Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.
  • Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.
  • Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.
  • Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.
  • Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

What You Will Bring to the Table

We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).
  • Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.
  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.
  • A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.
  • Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.
  • Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.
  • A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

jobs.title: Spiralyze: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, Georgia
URL: https://www.spiralyze.com/

The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do.

Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplines—research, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.
 

Key Responsibilities

You’ll own three core responsibilities:
  1.  Coordination. You’ll manage cross-functional teams of 5–10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea → build → launch → analysis. You’ll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  2.  Strategy & Planning. You’ll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10–20 upcoming experiments. You’ll communicate the “why” behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.
  3.  Energy (“Vibes”). You’re the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

Skills, Knowledge and Traits

You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Here’s what we need from you:

  2.  Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.

jobs.title: Expel: Product Manager, Detection Pipeline
jobs.description:

You live at the intersection of security and product management, and there's no place you'd rather be. You understand that the detection pipeline isn't just plumbing. It's the connective tissue that turns raw security data into signal, and if ingestion, normalization, or correlation break down, everything downstream suffers. You're not intimidated by the scale and complexity of data flowing through a modern security platform. Quite the opposite: you pride yourself on knowing how data moves from source to detection, where the pipeline breaks, and what it takes to make it fast, reliable, and cost effective.

You’ve got an informed opinion about what an MDR should detect, an opinion that comes from customer empathy, hands-on industry knowledge, and a set of experiences that didn’t always go as planned. You can hold a technical conversation with a SOC analyst and turn around and explain the same thing to a Sales team in plain English. You've been waiting for a role where that combination of skills actually matters.

Still reading? Great. This role isn't for all PMs. Yes, all the standard PM things apply: plan, prioritize, communicate, and own a roadmap, build relationships, and become the authority on how internal teams and customers use your platform. But in this role, you'll bring your security experience to bear on one of the most foundational parts of Expel's platform. If you get your energy from untangling how security data flows through a platform at scale and turning that into a roadmap that makes customers safer, you'll thrive here.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you clear ownership of a product area with measurable impact on customer value and business outcomes.
  • Surround you with experienced security practitioners, engineers, and operators who are genuinely invested in building something great.

  • Broad knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and where security risks emerge in those environments.
  • Experience with SIEM technologies is highly desired — bonus points if you've navigated integration or data pipeline challenges firsthand.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can write a crisp user story and present to a customer in the same afternoon.
  • The ability to build trust across Engineering, Security Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and UX.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: US

Head of Growth & Operations — Openbase.ai

Full-time | Remote | Reports directly to the Founder

About Openbase

Openbase.ai is an AI gateway that helps developers and businesses access multiple AI models through one API. We simplify model access, routing, and usage management so teams can focus on building AI products.

Our MVP is ready. We are hiring a hands-on leader to own our go-to-market strategy, day-to-day business execution, and journey from launch to our first 10,000 users.

The opportunity

You will work directly with the founder to turn Openbase into a growing business with repeatable customer acquisition, strong retention, and disciplined operations.

You will own the commercial execution: finding our first customers, testing acquisition channels, improving onboarding, building partnerships, and organizing the people and systems needed to grow.

Our ambition is 10,000 users. Your responsibility is to build a credible, measurable path toward that goal, with clear milestones for activated developers, retained customers, paying accounts, and profitable usage.

What you will own

1. Go-to-market and customer acquisition

  • Identify our strongest initial customer segments, including AI startups, independent developers, agencies, and software teams.
  • Develop our positioning and explain why developers should choose Openbase.
  • Launch and improve acquisition across X, SEO, visibility in AI search engines, developer communities, partnerships, and targeted outbound.
  • Test paid campaigns with clear budgets, conversion tracking, and criteria for scaling or stopping.
  • Build a growth roadmap with weekly experiments and monthly acquisition targets.

2. Developer activation and retention

  • Own the journey from website visit to signup, first successful API request, first payment, and ongoing usage.
  • Work with engineering to remove onboarding friction and improve documentation, quickstarts, and integration examples.
  • Speak directly with developers to understand why they try Openbase, keep using it, or leave.
  • Establish onboarding communications, customer support processes, and reactivation campaigns.
  • Turn successful customer implementations into case studies and referrals.

3. Sales and partnerships

  • Personally source and close early customers.
  • Build a qualified pipeline of startups and businesses with recurring AI usage.
  • Develop distribution partnerships with developer tools, AI communities, accelerators, and complementary platforms.
  • Coordinate technical evaluations and customer requirements with engineering.
  • Build a repeatable sales process as demand grows.

4. Business execution and team management

  • Translate company goals into weekly priorities, accountable owners, and delivery dates.
  • Recruit and manage freelancers, agencies, and future hires across growth, content, developer relations, and customer success.
  • Own marketing budget allocation and evaluate spending against business results.
  • Coordinate customer needs with product and engineering priorities.
  • Implement practical workflows and automation that reduce manual work.

5. Metrics and commercial performance

  • Maintain a dashboard covering acquisition, activation, retention, paying customers, and API usage.
  • Track customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, and retention by channel.
  • Separate customer spending from provider costs and Openbase’s retained revenue and gross profit.
  • Monitor promotional credits and infrastructure costs so growth remains economically sound.
  • Give the founder a clear weekly view of results, blockers, and decisions needed.

What we are looking for

  • Experience leading growth and commercial execution at an early-stage SaaS, API, developer-tools, or AI infrastructure company.
  • Evidence of acquiring users from an early starting point, with specific numbers and your personal contribution.
  • Understanding of developer audiences and how technical products earn adoption.
  • Ability to understand an API integration, follow documentation, and discuss onboarding issues with engineers.
  • Hands-on ability to run experiments, analyze funnels, conduct customer calls, and manage delivery.
  • Experience managing budgets and external specialists.
  • Strong written English, sound judgment, and comfort working directly with a founder.

Experience with usage-based pricing, developer relations, technical SEO, and AI model platforms is particularly relevant.

Why join

  • Direct ownership of Openbase’s launch and growth.
  • Close collaboration with the founder and engineering team.
  • The opportunity to build the commercial function from its earliest stage.
  • Scope to take on broader company leadership as the business grows.

How to apply

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, together with brief answers to:

  1. Which product have you helped grow? Include starting users, ending users, timeframe, budget, and your exact role.
  2. Which acquisition channels produced retained or paying customers?
  3. How would you approach Openbase’s first 1,000 activated developers?
  4. What would you personally execute, and where would you use specialists?
  5. What are your location, availability, and compensation expectations?

Include an example of a growth experiment or operating system you built. Share only information you are authorized to disclose.

jobs.title: Airbnb: Senior Manager, Quality, Volume Tiers
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb/

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Senior Quality Lead, Volume Tiers is the single accountable leader for quality measurement, insights, and continuous improvement across Airbnb's highest-volume Community Support functions. This role owns the end-to-end quality program for:

  1. Global English (GE)
  2. Rest of World (ROW; which is comprised of 9 different languages)
  3. Elevated Support

GE and ROW span across multiple service tiers: Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support (DSS), Dedicated Managed Host Support (DMHS); supported across a global partner network operating 24/7 in dozens of languages.

The Difference You will Make:

This is a senior leadership role operating at the intersection of strategy and execution. The Senior Quality Lead will break down silos within the Quality organization, establish a unified operating model, and leverage AI-powered tools to scale quality insights. This leader will work closely with Service Delivery, Training, Business Process Improvement, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, remediate issues, and ensure Airbnb is providing its global partner network a unified set of priorities.

The successful candidate will establish themselves as a credible partner to stakeholders and be recognized internally as the voice of quality for the Volume Tier portfolio.

A Typical Day:

Strategic Leadership & Program Ownership

  • Own and execute the Volume Tier quality strategy aligned to several critical priorities: breaking silos, aligning with stakeholders, defining a clear operating model, and driving measurable impact.
  • Consolidate fragmented QA frameworks across GE and ROW into a unified operating model, eliminating inconsistent processes, divergent NPS detractor approaches, and incompatible quality signals.
  • Represent Volume Tier quality in WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and cross-functional planning forums; bring a proactive, narrative-led perspective that gives leadership visibility before problems surface in operational reviews.

Measurement & Quality Execution

  • Oversee QA evaluation execution across all Volume Tier partner sites globally, ensuring consistent application of QA processes and frameworks.
  • Lead root cause analysis on systemic failures, translating QA findings into product, process, and policy recommendations that go beyond agent-level coaching.
  • Formalize Audit the Auditor as an ongoing control: define sample selection, alignment thresholds, root cause review, and evaluator-level remediation processes.
  • Ensure every evaluation closes with a documented coaching action; build the tracking mechanisms to measure whether coaching is translating into performance improvement over time.

Insights, Reporting & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Establish automated KPI reporting across all Volume Tier sites, tiers, and languages, eliminating manual processes.
  • Unify NPS detractor analysis across GE and ROW, ensuring global patterns surface in real time.
  • Build a Partner QA Performance Scorecard, establishing clear accountability for Calibration Accuracy, Evaluation Completeness, Critical Error Detection, Coaching Effectiveness.

AI & Technology Enablement

  • Lead the deployment of AutoQA (via Observe.AI) across Volume Tiers; partner with the Platform team to ensure appropriate sequencing.
  • Build and govern a clear accountability framework for AI-assisted quality tools and processes.

People & Culture Leadership

  • Lead a globally distributed team of Partner Quality Leads and Quality Insights Analysts.
  • Foster a One-Quality-Team culture that eliminates the cross-team divides: shared best practices, cross-regional learning, and proactive knowledge sharing.
  • Set high expectations and hold the team accountable for output quality, insight delivery, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Partner closely with peers to ensure one consistent quality voice across the portfolio.

Your Expertise:

  • 12+ years of experience in Customer/Community Support, Quality Assurance, or Contact Center Operations, with direct accountability for large-scale, multilingual QA programs.
  • 5+ years managing globally distributed QA teams across multiple languages, regions, and partner organizations in a 24/7 support environment.
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience, preferably in related field; MBA or Masters preferred
  • Experience with QA tooling platforms, including hands-on ownership of form design, calibration management, and AutoQA deployment.
  • Deep expertise in quality methodologies (COPC, AQS, Six Sigma, Lean), with a proven ability to apply them to high-volume, complex support environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading quality transformation, consolidating fragmented programs, driving measurable improvement in NPS/CSAT, and QA calibrations.
  • Experience deploying or scaling AI/ML assisted QA tools (AutoQA, predictive NPS/CSAT).
  • Strong executive presence: able to influence senior stakeholders, present a unified quality narrative in leadership forums, and drive alignment across stakeholders.
  • Experience managing vendor partner governance: calibration oversight, performance improvement plans, and escalation frameworks.

Preferred

  • COPC certification; Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.
  • Experience with Observe.AI.
  • Background in program management, change management, or organizational design within a high-growth tech environment.
  • Experience working in or closely with BPO/vendor governance models at scale (1,000+ partner FTEs across multiple sites and geographies).

Your Location:

This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, Alberta, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

We use automated tools to help our recruiting team efficiently screen a large volume of applications. All final hiring decisions are made by a human reviewer.

This role is newly created and does not replace or backfill an existing position.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Canada Annual Pay Range

$160,000—$200,000 CAD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Engine : VP, Finance
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://engine.com/

About the Role

We're looking for a VP, Finance to lead Finance at Engine and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive leadership team. 

You'll own the financial strategy and operating cadence of the company, from planning and forecasting to capital allocation, business performance, financial reporting, and long-range strategy. You'll help leadership understand what is driving the business, where we should invest, and what we need to do next. You'll also be the architect of Engine's financial story, shaping how the company is understood by its Board, investors, and partners.

You'll build the Finance organization and infrastructure to support Engine through its next phase of growth. That means creating clarity where there is ambiguity, building scalable processes before they become bottlenecks, and using data, systems, and AI to make Finance increasingly leveraged.

Success in this role will be measured by business impact and the results of the Finance organization.

What You'll Do

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Serve as the CEO's financial thought partner on growth strategy, investment priorities, resource allocation, and profitability. Drive capital allocation decisions across the executive team — where Engine invests people, capital, and resources, and where we make tradeoffs. Bring financial rigor to pricing, monetization, new products, markets, and partnerships.

Capital Strategy & Transactions

  • Own fundraising, debt and liquidity strategy, M&A, and other strategic transactions. Build investor relationships, lead the Board story on performance, and prepare Engine for future capital events — including the reporting, controls, and governance a public-ready company requires (SOX readiness, audit committee partnership, external guidance frameworks).

Financial Planning & Business Insight

  • Own the financial plan — quarterly forecasting, long-range modeling, scenario analysis, and the operating cadence across Engine. Develop a deep understanding of revenue, margins, customer economics, pricing, payment economics, and cash flow. Build the metrics and frameworks that make the business legible to leadership.

Narrative & Communication

  • Tell Engine's financial story to the Board, investors, lenders, and partners — turning complex numbers into a narrative leadership can act on and external audiences believe. Lead financial reporting and help the CEO communicate performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and key decisions with clarity.

Build Finance for Scale

  • Build and lead a high-performance Finance team — attracting exceptional talent, modernizing through AI and automation, and establishing systems, processes, data infrastructure, and controls that scale without creating bureaucracy. Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and external advisors to ensure Engine has the financial foundation required to scale responsibly.

What You'll Bring

Experience and Background

  • 12+ years of experience across investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or a related field, with significant experience in high-growth technology.
  • Investment banking or private equity background, with hands-on experience in valuation, transaction execution, and capital markets. Strongly preferred.
  • Experience leading Finance, or a major component of Finance, at a high-growth tech, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or similarly complex company.

Financial Expertise

  • Exceptional financial modeling skills and a strong understanding of three-statement modeling, unit economics, cash flow, and capital allocation.
  • A track record of building financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytical infrastructure in environments that are scaling quickly.

jobs.title: Oportun: Principal Product Manager, Savings (R13997)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Oportun’s flagship, AI-powered Savings product. Savings is an important driver of member growth and retention, giving this role significant influence over the future of our financial health platform and how we help members build stronger financial futures.

You’ll lead the ideation, development, launch, and scaling of new products and features while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support. This role reports to the Vice President & General Manager for Savings and Mobile. Candidates located in Central or Eastern time zones are strongly preferred to support team and stakeholder collaboration.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll lead the long-term product strategy and roadmap for Oportun’s Savings product in partnership with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • You’ll scope and lead the development of new products and features designed to improve members’ financial health and strengthen growth and retention.
  • You’ll use customer research, experimentation, data, and product metrics to build a deep understanding of member needs and behaviors and translate those insights into product decisions.
  • You’ll lead a high-performing cross-functional product team across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support to bring new capabilities to market.
  • You’ll drive alignment across teams and leadership through clear communication, thoughtful documentation, and strong product judgment.
  • You’ll navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations while keeping the team focused on member outcomes and execution.
  • You’ll bring ideas for how we can do things better, proactively, not just when asked.
  • You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate product discovery, improve decision-making, reduce manual work, and create stronger member experiences.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a curious and creative product leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning customer needs into clear product strategies. You combine strong product judgment with data, move comfortably between strategy and execution, and build trust across a wide range of partners.

You’re customer-focused, solution-oriented, and comfortable navigating complexity without waiting for perfect information. You communicate clearly, build alignment, and keep teams moving toward meaningful outcomes.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including experience building and scaling products in high-growth environments.
  • A strong track record of defining product strategy, building roadmaps, and shipping products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong customer orientation and a passion for building products that improve financial health.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with experimentation, product metrics, data analysis, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product teams and building alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, Customer Support, and senior leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex product decisions clearly and concisely.
  • Experience navigating ambiguity, removing blockers, and driving execution across complex product initiatives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, digital banking, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience launching products within complex legal or regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience using SQL or similar tools to support product analysis and decision-making.
  • Experience working with globally distributed or multinational teams.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools to improve product discovery, analysis, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. jobs.title: Semaphore: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Novi Sad
URL: https://semaphore.io/

About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.


We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.


About the role

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets.


AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.


This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

  • Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.
  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.
  • Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.
  • Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.
  • Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly.

What we are looking for

  • A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities.
  • Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet.
  • Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms.
  • Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required.
  • Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change.
  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow.
    Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result.
  • Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.


We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack.


Nice to have

  • Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it.
  • Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations.

What success looks like

Within your first three months:

  • You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production.
  • Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope.
  • You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention.
  • You are using AI coding agents to increase your output while keeping the resulting systems understandable, tested, and reliable.
  • Product and engineering decisions move faster because you bring clear options, make sound calls, and follow through.
  • The team trusts you with an ambiguous new product or feature and expects you to drive it to a strong result.

How you will work

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership. You will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and company leadership. Teams are small, communication is direct, and the person closest to the work is expected to exercise judgment.


You will have room to shape both the product and its implementation. In return, we expect you to take responsibility for the whole outcome: what gets built, why it matters, how well it works, and what happens after it ships.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/semaphore-senior-product-engineer

jobs.title: Webflow: Senior Developer Educator
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid); U.S. Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Developer Educator to help us create best-in-class video, written, and hands-on education content for Webflow customers, and those who want to define the next phases of the web. You’ll present on camera as a developer educator, and,  to keep your skills fresh, you’ll build production grade sites using Webflow that we use in our education videos and courses. You’ll also keep your skills fresh by learning how to integrate Webflow with other services and technologies and then develop content demonstrating how.

About the role:

  • Location: San Francisco HQ or Remote (United States)
    • Travel required to SF - 1 week per month
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $129,000 - $155,000
      • Zone B: $121,500 - $146,000
      • Zone C: $113,000 - $136,000

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals. 

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position

  • Reporting to the Director, Education Video

 As a Senior Developer Educator you’ll … 

  • Build the reference websites that anchor Webflow University courses, tutorials, and live training — real, production-quality sites and components that hold up to scrutiny from developers and designers, not just demos that survive a screen recording (see examples in our videos at Webflow University)
  • Shape technical curriculum in partnership with instructional designers and video producers, scoping what each lesson needs to demonstrate and why, before anything gets built or shot
  • Present technical content on camera for tutorials, course lessons, and live sessions — walking through code and craft with the clarity of someone who actually built the thing
  • Work alongside video producers and instructional designers through pre-production, shooting, and review, so what's on screen empowers learners to do the thing
  • Serve as the education team's technical subject matter expert, reviewing content for accuracy and pressure-testing it against how people really work and build
  • Keep the technical library current as the platform ships, deciding what's gone stale, what needs rebuilding, and what's newly worth teaching
  • Partner with product and engineering to understand what's coming, so education is ready when it launches rather than catching up after

About you:

Requirements:

  • 4+  years of experience in technical education and web development and/or design
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to write, review, and explain code - leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and refine quality.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching technical concepts to a mixed audience through video, documentation, courses, workshops, or community work
  • Willingness and ability to present on camera - from an outline or word-for-word script, in studio or from your own home setup

You’ll thrive as a Senior Technical Educator if you:

  • Build things because you need to understand them, not just to ship them
  • Can address multiple audiences — the visual developer who's never opened a code editor, the engineer evaluating how Webflow can help them build better, and the marketer who’s been handed off components and templates to build with
  • Take feedback on your on-camera work as craft input rather than personal critique
  • Enjoy collaborating with technical and less technical education teammates alike, recognizing the unique role each person plays in the success of a project
  • Are passionate about learning, education, and helping others succeed
  • Are equally confident showing the messy middle of a build or the polished result
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Stay connected

jobs.title: Twikey: Senior Java Developer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium
URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.
  • With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.
  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.
  • You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.
  • You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.
  • You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
  • You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

  • An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.
  • The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.
  • An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!
  • A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.
  • A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

  • A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.

jobs.title: Jobhire: CRM/ CVM / Lifecycle/Retention Marketing Lead (US b2c subscription only)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Bulgaria
URL: http://jobhire.ai

Description

CVM Lead (US Market)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

About JobHire.AI

JobHire.AI is a vertical AI agent that automates job search for professionals in the US market. We find, tailor, and apply to jobs on behalf of thousands of paying subscribers — at scale and with precision. We operate a subscription model with monthly and longer-term tiers, plus paid add-ons. We're entering a phase where deeper customer value management — not just acquisition — is the single biggest unlock for profitable growth.

Why This Role Now

We are spending efficiently to acquire users — but a substantial portion of revenue is left on the table after the first purchase. Reg→Purchase conversion is below where it should be. Rebill rates erode quickly past month one. Add-on attach is minimal. Our reactivation engine is currently offline. We've been operating an email-only CRM on a platform that doesn't return analytics through its API.

That ends with this hire. This is a role for someone who has already done the transformation we need: turning a basic broadcast CRM into a measurable CVM function that drives incremental revenue across email, SMS, and web push — on the US market specifically.

What You'll Own

Funnel Conversion

  • Drive Reg→Purchase conversion through triggered post-quiz, paywall-abandonment, and onboarding sequences across email, SMS, and web push.
  • Own first-purchase activation across the first 7 days.

Retention & Rebill

  • Differentiate renewal sequences by plan tier (1 / 3 / 6 month).
  • Build pre-cancel intervention flows — pause offer, plan-switch, value reminder — using captured cancel reason.
  • Move the dial on month-1 rebill rate, the single most leveraged metric in our subscription economics.

Reactivation

  • Build the reactivation engine for the cancelled cohort — across email and SMS, personalized by cancel reason and tenure.
  • Recover revenue from a base that is currently dormant due to deliverability issues.

Add-on Monetization

  • Own the CRM-driven path to add-on products (Resume Review, Resume Builder): timing, segmentation, copy, channel.

Channel & Tooling

  • Lead the migration off our current ESP onto our chosen omnichannel platform (Maestra is the current candidate; Customer.io is the alternative).
  • Recover and maintain email domain reputation.
  • Stand up SMS as a first-class channel — including US compliance (TCPA, A2P 10DLC).
  • Stand up web push and orchestrate cross-channel flows (email → SMS → push cascades).

Measurement

  • Implement incremental measurement with holdouts on every flow. We don't want activity reports — we want incremental revenue, attributable and defensible.

Expected Outcomes

First 3 Months

  1. Email deliverability restored to historical baseline.
  2. Reactivation campaign launched with measurable incremental conversion against a holdout.
  3. Differentiated renewal flows live for 1 / 3 / 6 month plans.
  4. Decision (signed off with engineering) on omnichannel platform: migrate to Maestra or alternative.

First 6 Months

  1. SMS and web push live as ongoing production channels in lifecycle flows.
  2. Measurable lift in Reg→Purchase conversion via paywall-abandonment and post-registration triggered sequences.
  3. Measurable lift in month-1 rebill rate via differentiated and intervention flows.
  4. Add-on attach rate (Resume Review, Resume Builder) materially up via CRM-driven sales sequences.
  5. Per-flow incremental revenue reported weekly via proper holdout methodology.

12 Months

  1. CVM channel contributing as a top-3 incremental revenue source for the company.
  2. Cross-channel lifecycle strategy (email + SMS + web push + iMessage/RCS as those channels mature in the US) live and documented.
  3. Process documentation and tooling stable enough to remove key-person risk.


We keep our hiring process quick and simple:

  • HR Introduction Call
  • Team Interviews
  • Challenge
  • Reference Check (with three prior managers)


Requirements

You're a Fit If You Have

  • 3+ years operating CVM/lifecycle programs on the US market specifically. US b2c subscription. This is non-negotiable — US deliverability, US carriers, US consumer behavior, US compliance.
  • 5+ years total in CRM / lifecycle / CVM, with at least one stint owning the function end-to-end (not just executing).
  • Hands-on operating experience with an enterprise omnichannel platform — Maestra strongly preferred; Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or Klaviyo also relevant.
  • Real, hands-on experience launching SMS as a marketing channel in the US (TCPA, A2P 10DLC, carrier compliance — not "I worked with a vendor who handled it").
  • Real, hands-on experience launching web push and measuring its lift.
  • SQL good enough to pull your own segments and validate your own data.
  • A subscription-business orientation: you think in LTV/payer, payback period, retention curves, and cohorts — not in opens and clicks.
  • A track record of measurable incremental revenue from CRM, ideally validated through holdout.
  • Bias toward action. We operate as a tiny team; you'll need to ship faster than you plan.

Nice to Have

  • Experience migrating off a damaged email domain.
  • Experience in job search, career, HR-tech, or adjacent consumer subscription verticals (EdTech, FinTech, dating, streaming).
  • iMessage Business / RCS experience.
  • Communication (speak English and Russian).


Benefits

  • Clear mandate and ownership from day one. You're the function, not a contributor to it.
  • The economics are highly leveraged — even a 5-percentage-point lift on month-1 rebill is meaningful to the bottom line of the company.
  • Direct work with the CMO, CEO, and Growth PM. No layers, no politics.
  • A market where your work is directly visible to users searching for their next job — outcomes you can feel.
  • $4000-7000/month + 38DaysOff.
