  • Du nutzt KI- und Automatisierungstools sinnvoll, um Informationen aufzubereiten und Arbeitsabläufe zu verbessern.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch – schriftlich wie mündlich.
  • Du organisierst dich selbstständig, setzt Prioritäten und verfolgst offene Aufgaben konsequent.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Du verbindest Kundenkontakt, Projektarbeit, Technologie und operative Logistik.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsleitung, Operations und IT zusammen.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Du baust dein Wissen in E-Commerce, internationalem Versand, Software und Automatisierung aus.
  • Gut erreichbarer Standort in Hamburg: Unser Büro liegt in unmittelbarer Nähe der S-Bahn-Station Eidelstedt.
  • Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Frühstück, bezuschusstes Mittagessen, Zuschuss zur HVV-Karte sowie kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten.
  • Weiterbildung und Sonderzahlungen: Betriebliche und digitale Schulungen sowie Urlaubsgeld und Erfolgszahlungen.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Du möchtest Kunden begeistern, Abläufe verbessern und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

Gestalte mit uns, wie Unternehmen weltweit versenden.

À propos de Scento

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe.

Le poste

L'acquisition payante est l'un des principaux moteurs de croissance de Scento. Nous vendons des décants de parfum de créateurs et de niche à des clients répartis sur 27 marchés européens, avec des budgets mensuels importants à placer sur Meta, Google et de nouveaux canaux.

En tant que Senior Performance Marketing Manager, vous êtes responsable de la performance de ces comptes. Le succès, c'est un CAC maîtrisé, un délai de retour sur investissement qui respecte nos objectifs, et une capacité à identifier vite ce qu'il faut arrêter et ce qu'il faut amplifier.

Vos missions

  • Vous pilotez et faites monter en puissance les comptes Meta et Google de Scento (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Advantage+) sur les marchés européens.
  • Vous gérez budgets, enchères, structure de compte et tests, au regard d'objectifs de CAC et de délai de retour.
  • Vous briefez et testez les créations avec l'équipe marque, lisez la donnée créative et décidez vite d'arrêter ou d'amplifier.
  • Vous veillez à la santé du tracking avec l'analytics et la data (Conversions API, conversions avancées, GA4).
  • Vous ouvrez de nouveaux marchés et de nouveaux canaux, comme TikTok et Microsoft Ads, quand les chiffres le justifient.

Votre profil

  • Plus de 6 ans d'acquisition payante en e-commerce, avec de gros budgets mensuels.
  • Une expertise approfondie de Meta Ads et de Google Ads, et de solides compétences en tableurs et en analytics.
  • Une expérience sur plusieurs pays européens.
  • Un anglais courant ; le français ou l'allemand est un plus.

Ce que nous proposons

  • Une rémunération située dans le haut du marché, complétée par une prime annuelle sur performance.
  • Du télétravail possible partout dans l'UE, avec des bureaux à Paris (place Vendôme) et à Berlin.
  • Une généreuse allocation mensuelle de parfums pour explorer l'ensemble du catalogue.
  • Un budget de formation personnel de 2 500 € par an (cours, conférences, livres).
  • Le matériel de votre choix et un budget d'aménagement de votre espace de travail.
  • Une vraie autonomie et des décisions rapides, dans une entreprise qui se développe vite à travers l'Europe.

Rémunération et candidature

Rémunération : de 95 000 € à 125 000 € brut par an, en CDI à temps plein, plus une prime annuelle sur performance.

Lieu : Paris ou Berlin, ou en télétravail depuis toute l'Union européenne.

jobs.title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

Poste : Technicien (position 2.1, coefficient 275, convention collective Syntec) · Basé en France · Interventions sur notre infrastructure, partout en France et à l'international

Vous aimez le terrain, les sites qui ne se ressemblent pas et le moment où le lien monte enfin. Chez Azurreo, vous installez, raccordez, testez et dépannez notre propre infrastructure réseaux et télécoms, celle qui fait tourner nos activités et nos plateformes à travers le monde.

Un poste de terrain, mais avec des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi, des heures supplémentaires payées et inscrites au contrat, des frais avancés par l'entreprise, et vos habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas encore.

Qui nous sommes

Azurreo est la branche télécommunications et technologies de Seelon Holdings, groupe d'investissement international présent sur quatre continents. Nous sommes un acteur de référence du test de performance des réseaux : notre plateforme SignalVerify mesure la qualité de service et la qualité d'expérience des réseaux dans plus de 144 pays.

Depuis plus de quinze ans, nous accompagnons opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs, constructeurs et grandes entreprises dans le déploiement et la maintenance de leurs infrastructures en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique : plus de 250 projets livrés dans plus de 25 pays.

Pour soutenir cette activité, Azurreo exploite et entretient son propre réseau d'infrastructures techniques en France et à l'international. C'est cette infrastructure que vous aurez en charge : celle qui permet à nos équipes et à nos plateformes de fonctionner, jour après jour, partout où nous sommes présents.

À quoi ressemble une semaine

Aucune semaine n'est identique :

  • Installation. Montage d'une baie sur l'un de nos sites, raccordement, brassage, étiquetage, tests, mise en service.

  • Dépannage. Une liaison qui ne monte pas depuis trois jours. Le plan de câblage ne correspond pas à l'existant. Vous cherchez, vous mesurez, vous trouvez, et vous écrivez ce que vous avez trouvé.

  • Datacenter. Rack & stack, cross-connects, mise en place d'équipements actifs.

  • Déploiement multi-sites. Plusieurs de nos sites dans la même semaine : bornes Wi-Fi, switches, configuration de base, comptes rendus.

  • Missions à l'international. Certaines semaines vous emmènent sur nos sites hors de France.

  • Journées base arrière. Préparation du matériel, gestion des stocks et de l'outillage, maintenance préventive, mise à jour des tickets. Toutes les semaines ne sont pas des semaines de route.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Installation et déploiement. Installation et mise en service d'équipements télécoms et informatiques sur nos sites. Câblage, raccordement et brassage. Déploiement de routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi et équipements de connectivité. Préparation du matériel avant intervention, participation aux migrations et déploiements sur nos infrastructures.

  • Maintenance et support technique. Maintenance préventive et corrective de nos équipements. Diagnostic des incidents et mise en œuvre des dépannages. Remplacement et reconfiguration d'équipements défectueux. Vérification du bon fonctionnement après intervention.

  • Suivi et reporting. Rédaction des comptes rendus d'intervention, mise à jour des outils de suivi et des tickets d'incidents, gestion du matériel confié, participation aux stocks et inventaires, remontée des anomalies aux équipes concernées.

  • Qualité et sécurité. Respect des procédures qualité et sécurité d'Azurreo et des consignes propres à chaque site, usage approprié des équipements et outils mis à disposition.

Les technologies que vous rencontrerez

  • Réseaux : TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, VPN, LAN / WAN

  • Constructeurs : Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet, Juniper

  • Télécoms : fibre optique, FTTH, FTTO, RJ45, brassage, baies informatiques

  • Datacenter : rack & stack, cross-connect, installation, maintenance

Vous ne maîtrisez pas tout cela ? Personne ne le maîtrise entièrement. Nous cherchons de bonnes bases techniques, de la curiosité et de la rigueur. Le reste s'apprend.

Parlons des déplacements franchement

  • Les déplacements en France et à l'international font partie intégrante du poste : ce n'est pas occasionnel, c'est une exigence.

  • Le rythme varie réellement selon les projets : certaines semaines sans déplacement, d'autres avec des découchés en France ou à l'étranger. Nous ne garantissons pas de rythme fixe.

  • Le véhicule utilitaire est mis à disposition pour les interventions en France : ce n'est pas un véhicule de fonction et il ne rentre pas chez vous le soir.

  • Les imprévus font partie du métier : matériel non livré, local fermé, câblage existant non conforme au plan.

  • Il y a de la manutention, des faux plafonds et des locaux techniques exigus.

  • En contrepartie : tous les frais professionnels sont pris en charge en amont, les horaires restent fixes, les heures supplémentaires sont payées, et vous ne passez pas vos journées au même bureau à faire la même chose.

Le profil que nous cherchons

Indispensable

  • Résider en France

  • Permis B en cours de validité

  • Disponible pour des déplacements fréquents, en France et à l'international

  • Formation ou expérience dans les télécommunications, les réseaux ou les infrastructures techniques

  • Connaissances en réseaux informatiques, câblage RJ45 et fibre optique

  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des incidents techniques

  • Français courant, anglais niveau A2 minimum (à l'oral et pour lire de la documentation technique)

  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants

  • Autonomie, rigueur, organisation

  • Capacité à travailler en mobilité et à vous adapter à des environnements techniques variés

Apprécié, mais pas exigé

  • Anglais au-delà du niveau A2

  • Expérience sur équipements Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Fortinet ou Juniper

  • Fibre optique : raccordement, soudure, mesures. Wi-Fi, datacenter

  • Certifications réseau (CCNA ou équivalent) et habilitations à jour : AIPR, habilitation électrique, travail en hauteur, CACES nacelle, SST. Si vous ne les avez pas, nous organisons la formation pour que vous les obteniez.

Formation : Bac Pro SN, BTS SIO, BTS CIEL, BTS Télécommunications, BUT/DUT Réseaux & Télécommunications, Licence professionnelle Réseaux, ou expérience équivalente. Ce que vous avez fait compte autant que ce que vous avez étudié.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Des horaires fixes du lundi au vendredi et pas d'astreinte

  • Des heures supplémentaires payées, majorées et inscrites au contrat

  • Des frais avancés par l'entreprise

  • Vos certifications et habilitations financées si vous ne les avez pas

  • Une formation continue réelle, avec accès direct aux ingénieurs de l'entreprise

  • Des missions variées, en France et à l'international, sur notre propre infrastructure

Le processus de recrutement

  • Étude de votre candidature par notre équipe recrutement

  • Entretien RH, en visio (30 à 40 min), avec le recrutement, sur votre parcours, vos attentes et le poste en détail

L'embauche est conditionnée à une visite médicale d'aptitude au poste.

Comment candidater

Envoyez-nous votre CV. Pas besoin de lettre de motivation ; quelques lignes sur une intervention dont vous êtes fier (ce qu'il y avait à faire, ce qui a coincé, comment vous l'avez réglé) nous parlent davantage.

Azurreo étudie toutes les candidatures à compétences égales, sans distinction d'origine, de sexe, d'âge, de situation personnelle ou de handicap.

About Weezevent

From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.

We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control, CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.

Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.

Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).

Key Responsibilities:

Product Vision and Strategy: execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.

Stakeholder Collaboration: act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features.
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.

Product Backlog Management: create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.

Development and Delivery: work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines.
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.

Market and User Research: analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.

Compliance and Risk Management: ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.

Performance Monitoring: monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators.
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.

Why it's a good move ?
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.

Fundamentals to join us :

  • You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ;

  • You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

  • You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

  • You speak French fluently.

Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Compensation and benefits

We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues. A company laptop is provided from your first day.

Als Sales Representative voor de Nederlandse markt ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitbreiding en het beheer van het klantenbestand in dit specifieke segment. Je onderhoudt contacten met organisatoren van sportevenementen en bedrijven, introduceert de op maat gemaakte trofeeën en medailles, en begeleidt het volledige verkoopproces van de eerste kennismaking tot de uiteindelijke levering.

Je brengt commerciële ervaring mee in een buitendienstfunctie en bezit sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om duurzame klantrelaties op te bouwen. Een resultaatgerichte aanpak en doorzettingsvermogen zijn essentieel om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen en de groeidoelstellingen te behalen.

Voldoe je niet aan elk enkel punt, maar herken je jezelf wel in het grootste deel van de profielschets? Reageer dan alsnog.

In de eerste maanden maak je je de productlijnen van op maat gemaakte awards eigen en leg je de eerste contacten binnen de Nederlandse markt. Je bouwt een pipeline op en start met het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten voor sportevenementen en organisaties.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl

  • Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people

  • Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have

  • Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together

  • Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work

  • Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape

  • Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing

  • Dental insurance, including family cover

  • A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked

  • A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you

  • Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term

About the Interview

  • Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations)

  • Stage 2: Short task

  • Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops)

Additional Details

  • Team: Finance

  • Reports to: CEO

jobs.title: Closed Procedure: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
jobs.description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

jobs.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Bei erfolgreichem Abschluss deiner Ausbildung bieten wir dir gerne die Möglichkeit zur Übernahme und langfristige Perspektiven bei der teccle group. #letsteccleit

Was du bei uns lernst

Bei uns arbeitest du praxisnah, wirst Teil eines Teams und wächst mit deinen Aufgaben. Das erwartet dich in deiner Ausbildung:

  • Praxisnahe Arbeit mit modernen IT-Systemen - von Client- bis Server-Architekturen

  • IT-Systeme und Netzwerke planen, aufbauen und am Laufen halten - damit alles rund läuft

  • Netzwerktechnologien anwenden und vertiefen sowie Hosting- und Cloud-Lösungen nutzen

  • Hard- und Software einrichten, testen und pflegen - Hightech zum Anfassen inklusive

  • IT-Sicherheit im Blick behalten und Systeme so absichern, dass Hacker keine Chance haben

  • Fehler finden, Probleme lösen und Systeme optimieren - mit Köpfchen und Teamgeist

  • Dokumentationen erstellen und Anwender:innen unterstützen, damit Technik für alle verständlich bleibt

  • Spannende Einblicke in wichtige Unternehmensbereiche wie Vertrieb und Buchhaltung

  • IT-Fachkenntnisse vertiefen und ausbauen mit Unterstützung erfahrener IT-Expert:innen sowie durch regelmäßige Workshops und Schulungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Begeisterung mitbringst, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du kannst einen mindestens guten Schulabschluss vorweisen mit guten Noten in Englisch und Deutsch

  • Du bringst einen guten Teamgeist und Entscheidungsfreude mit

  • Du hast eine sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast eine gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und eine Kunden- und Serviceorientierung

  • Du hast kaufmännisches Denken und Verhandlungsgeschick (z.B. bei der Kalkulation von Kosten für Eigen- und Fremdleistungen, bei Vertragsverhandlungen)

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Frankfurt am Main und Umgebung und bist berechtigt in Deutschland zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Starte deine Ausbildung in einem Team, das dich unterstützt und dir richtig gute Extras bietet:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 28 Tage Urlaub und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Nach den ersten Monaten nach Absprache ein Tag pro Woche von zuhause möglich

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Individuelle Förderung, praxisnahes Lernen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Youngster Days zum Kennenlernen, ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Abläufe machen dir den Einstieg leicht

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Ausbildungsgehalt, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

  • Zukunft bei der teccle group: Wir bilden aus mit dem Ziel, dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss zu übernehmen

  

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

jobs.title: Chief E-Commerce Officer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Gestalte die Zukunft der Lederindustrie mit uns bei Gusti Leder 💻🌍✨

Tauche ein in die Welt von Gusti Leder, wo jede Tasche eine Geschichte erzählt und jedes Produkt mehr als nur ein Accessoire ist – es ist ein Statement für transparente Produktion und Stil. Bei Gusti Leder GmbH, einem Unternehmen, das für sein Engagement für Transparenz, Qualität und die Förderung von Slow Fashion bekannt ist, bieten wir Dir mehr als nur einen Job. Wir bieten Dir eine Chance, Teil einer Bewegung zu sein, die darauf abzielt, die Lederindustrie zum Besseren zu verändern.

Du denkst in digitalen Strategien, führst mit Weitblick und willst den E-Commerce eines Unternehmens nachhaltig gestalten und skalieren? Dann suchen wir dich als Chief E-Commerce Officer (m/w/d), um unser digitales Wachstum national wie international auf das nächste Level zu heben.

Deine Mission:

  • Strategie & Wachstum: Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere unternehmensweite E-Commerce-Strategie – mit einem klaren Fokus auf unsere Kernplattformen Shopify, Zalando und Amazon.

  • Digitale Umsatzverantwortung: Du steuerst alle Online-Vertriebskanäle, insbesondere Shopify, Zalando und Amazon mit dem Ziel, Umsatz, Marge und Effizienz kontinuierlich zu steigern.

  • Kundenerlebnis & Conversion: Du optimierst die digitale Customer Journey entlang aller Touchpoints – von der Traffic-Generierung über die Conversion bis zur Kundenbindung.

  • Führung & Zusammenarbeit: Du leitest ein interdisziplinäres E-Commerce-Team und arbeitest eng mit IT, Vertrieb, Logistik, Produkt und Management zusammen.

jobs.title: Freelance Acquisition Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) freelance spécialisé(e) en acquisition payante pour intervenir sur plusieurs projets e-commerce dans la beauté, la nutrition et la santé.

Notre terrain de jeu : l'acquisition payante nourrie par les contenus de créateurs. Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads, amplification de contenus UGC. Si vous savez transformer une vidéo de créatrice en campagne rentable, cette mission est pour vous.

Nous recherchons un partenaire capable aussi bien d'optimiser des dispositifs existants que de construire une stratégie paid media de A à Z pour de nouvelles marques ou de nouveaux marchés. Cette première mission pourra déboucher sur une collaboration récurrente.

Vos missions

1. Audit et optimisation de l'existant

  • Auditer les comptes Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Identifier les principaux freins à la performance (tracking, structure des campagnes, ciblages, créas, audiences, budget, attribution).

  • Construire un plan d'actions priorisé selon l'impact business, puis le mettre en œuvre.

  • Suivre les performances et formuler de nouvelles recommandations.

2. Amplification des contenus créateurs

  • Sélectionner les contenus UGC et créateurs à fort potentiel publicitaire.

  • Mettre en place les autorisations (Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads) avec les créateurs.

  • Tester les hooks, formats et angles, puis industrialiser ce qui performe.

3. Construction d'une stratégie d'acquisition sur un nouveau marché

Sur l'un des projets, vous définirez et déploierez une stratégie d'acquisition payante sur les réseaux sociaux pour accompagner le lancement d'un concept sur le marché américain : choix des plateformes et des formats, architecture des campagnes, audiences, premiers tests, optimisation continue.

Selon les projets, la mission pourra évoluer vers un pilotage mensuel des campagnes.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons un profil senior, opérationnel, qui pilote lui-même les comptes.

  • Indispensable : une expérience réelle des Spark Ads, du whitelisting ou des Creator Ads, avec des résultats à montrer.

  • Une excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Une solide expérience sur Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max).

  • Un tracking propre : GA4, GTM, Pixel, API Conversions.

  • Une approche orientée rentabilité : ROAS, CPA, marge.

  • Une expérience de marques e-commerce D2C (cosmétique, beauté, nutrition, santé) sera particulièrement appréciée, tout comme une expérience à l'international.

Conditions

  • Mission freelance, 350 à 380 € par jour selon profil.

  • 100 % à distance, depuis l'Europe : nous travaillons sur le fuseau de Paris et les échanges se font en journée (UTC-1 à UTC+3).

  • Statut d'indépendant en règle.

Pour postuler

Merci de nous donner un résultat chiffré avant / après sur une campagne que vous avez pilotée (ROAS, CPA ou CAC, budget mensuel, période). Les candidatures sans aucun chiffre ne seront pas étudiées.

Joignez aussi :

  • deux ou trois références de missions similaires, idéalement avec des contenus créateurs ;

  • votre niveau sur Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads ;

  • votre disponibilité pour démarrer.

jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day.

You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams.

This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage tracking data pipelines and infrastructure (event data, web tracking)

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and cost control (e.g. retention, storage optimization)

  • Build and optimize ELT pipelines using Python and SQL

  • Improve data ingestion and orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, APIs, S3, Iceberg, databases)

  • Support the shift toward streaming and modern analytics use cases

  • Collaborate with engineering teams (data producers) and analytics teams (data consumers)

  • Enable internal users by making data reliable, well-documented, and easy to use

Your profile

  • Experience in data engineering within cloud environments (AWS preferred)

  • Strong skills in Python and SQL

  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect), and APIs

  • Familiarity with large-scale data systems and event-based data (tracking, logs, or similar)

  • Experience with Snowflake (or similar DWH)

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)

  • Understanding of data architecture, testing, and best practices

  • Bonus: experience with DBT, streaming tools, or BI tools

What success looks like

  • You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable

  • You improve data reliability, usability, and cost efficiency

  • You collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • You bring structure to evolving systems while staying flexible in a dynamic environment

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

Tech Stack

jobs.title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
jobs.description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.


Salary & terms of employment

•      Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience

•      Year-end bonus, dependent on company results

•      25 holiday days per year

•      Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours

•      Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium

•      Laptop and phone provided


Working environment

•      Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data

•      Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines

•      Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme

•      An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative


Ready to build with us?

Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights
jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

Intersnack is building a next-generation AI and data foundation and this role is at the heart of making that foundation meaningful for the people who rely on it every day. As our AI Engineer for Analytics & End-User Insights, you will bridge the gap between enterprise data architecture and the business users who depend on trustworthy, actionable intelligence to make decisions. You will report into the AI Programme and collaborate across procurement, manufacturing, and sales to deliver AI-powered reporting that business teams can understand, trust, and act on. 

What We Can Offer 

You will join a collaborative, internationally minded team building something genuinely new: a modern, AI-grounded analytics capability that complements existing reporting and serves real business decisions. This role offers significant autonomy to shape how AI is introduced into the daily workflows of colleagues across multiple functions and countries. The impact of your work will be visible and measurable, from the moment a business user receives an AI-generated insight they trust, to the gradual reduction of manual reporting steps that once dominated their week. Dusseldorf serves as your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and the broader Intersnack network gives you exposure to a truly international operating environment. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights 

You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and business enablement: designing the data supply chain and semantic infrastructure that makes AI-driven analytics possible, while ensuring that the people who consume those analytics are equipped to use them with confidence. Your focus spans architecture and adoption in equal measure, working closely with business stakeholders to define what good looks like and then building the pipelines and models to get there. 

What You Will Do 

  • Design and implement decoupled data supply chains, spanning landing zones, quality and transformation layers, and consumption layers, to ensure consistently high-quality data reaches analytics and AI systems 

  • Implement and document business KPIs as defined by business stakeholders, ensuring full metric traceability; define, implement, and document technical KPIs for AI application performance in collaboration with the data architect, ensuring explainability and observability across all AI-driven outputs 

  • Build and maintain a semantic layer that enables AI-based insight generation, bridging structured data assets with natural-language querying and large language model (LLM) integration 

  • Lead the expansion of existing BI reporting with AI-supported, RAG-driven analytics, progressively complementing manual report runs with dynamic, contextual insight delivery 

  • Develop and maintain data models, transformations, and pipelines using industry-standard tooling, complementing existing data infrastructure and ensuring data quality, lineage, and observability throughout

Bad Homburg (Hybrid) – 75.000 € – 110.000 € Jahresgehalt, 30 Urlaubstage

Du willst nicht einfach irgendeinen Vertriebskanal bedienen. Du willst aktiv neue Banken und Private Banker gewinnen und den Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertrieb eigenverantwortlich ausbauen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Produktpräsentation. Hier geht es um den Aufbau eines bundesweiten Partnernetzwerks, um 30 % Jahresziel‑Bonus und um die Gestaltung deiner Vertriebsstrategie mit einem Top‑Verdienst von 75‑110 k €.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein unabhängiger Multi‑Asset‑Manager mit rund 65 Mrd. € verwalteten Vermögen und über 280 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten in Deutschland, Schweiz, Luxemburg und Österreich. Das Unternehmen bietet maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen über alle wesentlichen Assetklassen und zählt zu den führenden Anbietern im deutschsprachigen Raum. Es legt Wert auf Verantwortung, Authentizität, Integrität und Exzellenz.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Hoher Verdienst: attraktives Fixum plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus

  • Netzwerkaufbau: nutze und erweitere dein bestehendes Partnernetz zu Sparkassen, Genossenschafts‑ und Privatbanken

  • Investment‑ und Due‑Diligence‑Fokus: du bist maßgeblich an Fondsselektion, Manager‑Bewertung und Portfolio‑Konstruktion beteiligt

  • Hybrid Flexibilität: 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche, flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Produktentwicklung, Portfoliomanagement und Marketing

  • Monitoring von institutionellen Fonds und Mitgestaltung von Portfoliostrategien

Qualifikation

  • 3–8 Jahre Erfahrung im Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertrieb mit starkem Fokus auf Private Credit bzw. Private Markets Fund Investing, inkl. Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence und Bewertung.
